{{Quote|This is a joke, right? I don't care how many stormtroopers are coming. I'm ''not going in there''. I'd rather rot in an Imperial cell.|Tosk Millano|<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>}}
'''Tosk Millano''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] outlaw during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While being chased by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Millano refused to enter a sewer system in order to escape pursuit, preferring incarceration in an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="HS" />
